reading.title: The Impact of Remote Work on Urban Development
reading.passage: The rise of remote work has fundamentally changed how cities develop and grow. As more companies allow employees to work from home, the demand for large downtown office spaces has decreased significantly. This shift has prompted urban planners to repurpose vacant office buildings into residential apartments and creative spaces. Additionally, remote work enables professionals to live in smaller cities or suburban areas with lower costs of living, leading to more distributed population growth. However, this trend also raises concerns about reduced foot traffic in downtown areas, potentially affecting local restaurants and retail businesses that depend on commuting workers.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one effect of decreased demand for office spaces?
options: A) More people moving to downtown areas
B) Repurposing of office buildings into residential spaces
C) Increased traffic congestion
D) Higher costs of living in cities
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'urban planners to repurpose vacant office buildings into residential apartments and creative spaces'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 따라서 정답은 B번입니다.

questions.q: What concern is mentioned about remote work's impact on downtown areas?
options: A) Increased pollution from fewer commuters
B) Rise in property taxes
C) Reduced foot traffic affecting local businesses
D) Shortage of housing
questions.explanation: 마지막 문장에서 'reduced foot traffic in downtown areas, potentially affecting local restaurants and retail businesses that depend on commuting workers'라고 언급하고 있습니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is implied about professionals working remotely?
options: A) They prefer urban environments
B) They can choose to live in areas with lower living costs
C) They are less productive than office workers
D) They create more job opportunities downtown
questions.explanation: 'remote work enables professionals to live in smaller cities or suburban areas with lower costs of living'이라는 문장에서 원격근무자들이 더 저렴한 지역에 살 수 있다는 것을 암시하고 있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement that remote work has more benefits than drawbacks for society?

structure.intro: 서론에서 자신의 입장을 명확히 제시하세요. 예: 'I strongly agree that remote work has more benefits than drawbacks for society because...'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 주장: 원격근무의 경제적 이점 (개인의 생활비 절감, 기업의 부동산 비용 감소 등)을 구체적인 예시와 함께 설명
structure.body2: 두 번째 주장: 환경적 이점 (출퇴근 감소로 인한 탄소배출 감소) 또는 일과 삶의 균형 개선 언급
structure.conclusion: 재진술과 함께 전체 주장을 요약하고, 사회 전체에 미치는 긍정적 영향으로 마무리

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in a traditional office environment. Others prefer remote work. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer... because...
This is important to me because...
sample_points: 원격근무의 유연성 - 업무 시간과 장소를 선택할 수 있으며, 출퇴근 시간을 절약할 수 있습니다. 이는 개인의 생산성을 높이고 스트레스를 감소시킵니다.
비용 효율성 - 출퇴근 비용, 식사비, 옷값 등을 절약할 수 있으며, 더 저렴한 지역에 거주할 수 있습니다. 이는 장기적으로 경제적 이득을 제공합니다.

listening.title: University Career Services Office Discussion
listening.script: Student: Hi, I'm interested in learning about internship opportunities. I'm graduating next year and want to gain professional experience. Advisor: That's great! We have connections with many companies across different industries. Are you thinking about any particular field? Student: Well, I've been considering technology and finance sectors. The experience would really help my career prospects. Advisor: Excellent choices. Both sectors are competitive, but we have strong relationships with employers in these fields. I'd recommend updating your resume and practicing interview skills. We also host company information sessions every month where you can network directly with recruiters. Student: That sounds helpful. When is the next session? Advisor: The next one is in three weeks. I'll send you the schedule and registration information. In the meantime, come back and let's work on polishing your resume.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the student's visit?
options: A) To register for a class
B) To learn about internship opportunities
C) To schedule an appointment
D) To complain about a course
questions.explanation: 대화의 시작에서 학생이 'I'm interested in learning about internship opportunities'라고 명확하게 말하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What two sectors does the student mention as career interests?
options: A) Healthcare and education
B) Retail and hospitality
C) Technology and finance
D) Manufacturing and agriculture
questions.explanation: 학생이 'I've been considering technology and finance sectors'라고 명시적으로 언급하고 있습니다.

questions.q: What does the advisor recommend the student do before the information session?
options: A) Complete an internship application
B) Update resume and practice interview skills
C) Take a professional certification exam
D) Apply directly to companies
questions.explanation: 조언자가 'I'd recommend updating your resume and practicing interview skills'라고 제안하고 있습니다.
